external_deps: A supported coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex

review.tagline: Skill prompt that makes coding agents write less code and add tests
review.summary: Ponytail is a single prompt (SKILL.md, with a compact AGENTS.md) that loads into coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. It tells the agent to check existing code, the standard library and native platform features before writing anything, and adds /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit and /ponytail-debt commands. The README reports 53% less code and 45% fewer tokens in its own 39-task benchmark.
review.audience: Developers using Claude Code, Codex or similar agents who want smaller diffs
strengths: Works with 20 agents; plugin install for Claude Code and Codex, AGENTS.md for others
Benchmark method and per-task tables are published in the repo
Keeps validation, security and accessibility; leaves a small test for risky logic
No config file required; default level can be set by env var or JSON file
weaknesses: Benchmark figures are self-reported, run in Claude Code with Opus 5.5 only
Slash commands need a skill-capable host; rule-file adapters get only the always-on prompt
Cursor with hooks supports only /ponytail level switching, not review or audit
README is heavy on banners and a waitlist, with a jokey tone
needs: Needs A supported coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex
Models: Benchmarked with Opus 5.5 in Claude Code
